title: Zach Sieler: I love it here, I want to win as a Dolphin

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zach Sieler: I love it here, I want to win as a Dolphin
sources.description: The Dolphins parted ways with a lot of veteran players heading into the 2026 season, but defensive tackle Zach Sieler was not one of them.
